subject: MATH
title: Math 4
description: Fourth-grade mathematics aligned to the California Common Core State Standards. Students extend place value to 1,000,000, become fluent with multi-digit addition and subtraction, multiply up to four digits by one digit and two digits by two digits, and divide with remainders. The heart of the year is fractions (equivalence, comparison, adding/subtracting like denominators, multiplying a fraction by a whole number) and decimal notation, followed by measurement conversion, angle measurement and classification of two-dimensional figures.
framework: California Common Core State Standards for Mathematics; 2023 CA Mathematics Framework

standards.4.OA.A.1: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison (35 = 5 x 7 is 5 times as many as 7).
standards.4.OA.A.2: Multiply or divide to solve word problems involving multiplicative comparison.
standards.4.OA.A.3: Solve multistep word problems with whole numbers using all four operations, including interpreting remainders; check reasonableness with estimation.
standards.4.OA.B.4: Find all factor pairs for a whole number 1-100; recognize multiples; determine prime or composite.
standards.4.OA.C.5: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule and identify features of the pattern.
standards.4.NBT.A.1: Recognize that a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right.
standards.4.NBT.A.2: Read and write multi-digit whole numbers in base-ten numerals, number names and expanded form; compare using >, =, <.
standards.4.NBT.A.3: Use place value understanding to round multi-digit whole numbers to any place.
standards.4.NBT.B.4: Fluently add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.
standards.4.NBT.B.5: Multiply a whole number of up to four digits by a one-digit number and two two-digit numbers using place value strategies; illustrate with equations, arrays and area models.
standards.4.NBT.B.6: Find whole-number quotients and remainders with up to four-digit dividends and one-digit divisors using place value strategies.
standards.4.NF.A.1: Explain why a/b is equivalent to (n x a)/(n x b) using visual fraction models; generate equivalent fractions.
standards.4.NF.A.2: Compare two fractions with different numerators and denominators using common denominators/numerators or a benchmark such as 1/2.
standards.4.NF.B.3: Understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b; add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers with like denominators; solve word problems.
standards.4.NF.B.4: Multiply a fraction by a whole number; solve word problems involving multiplication of a fraction by a whole number.
standards.4.NF.C.5: Express a fraction with denominator 10 as an equivalent fraction with denominator 100 and add the two.
standards.4.NF.C.6: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100.
standards.4.NF.C.7: Compare two decimals to hundredths by reasoning about their size; record with >, =, <.
standards.4.MD.A.1: Know relative sizes of measurement units (km, m, cm; kg, g; lb, oz; l, ml; hr, min, sec) and express larger units in terms of smaller units.
standards.4.MD.A.2: Use the four operations to solve word problems involving distances, time, liquid volume, masses and money, including fractions and decimals.
standards.4.MD.A.3: Apply the area and perimeter formulas for rectangles in real-world and mathematical problems.
standards.4.MD.B.4: Make a line plot to display measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8) and solve problems using it.
standards.4.MD.C.5: Recognize angles as geometric shapes formed where two rays share an endpoint; understand degree measurement.
standards.4.MD.C.6: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; sketch angles of specified measure.
standards.4.MD.C.7: Recognize angle measure as additive; solve addition and subtraction problems to find unknown angles.
standards.4.G.A.1: Draw points, lines, line segments, rays, angles (right, acute, obtuse) and perpendicular and parallel lines.
standards.4.G.A.2: Classify two-dimensional figures based on parallel or perpendicular lines or angles of a specified size; recognize right triangles.
standards.4.G.A.3: Recognize a line of symmetry for a two-dimensional figure; identify line-symmetric figures and draw lines of symmetry.
standards.MP.1: Make sense of problems and persevere in solving them.
standards.MP.3: Construct viable arguments and critique the reasoning of others.

units.title: Place Value to One Million
units.big_idea: Each place is ten times the place to its right, which lets us read, compare and round big numbers.

units.title: Multi-Digit Addition & Subtraction
units.big_idea: The standard algorithm is place value regrouping written efficiently.

units.title: Multiplication: Comparison, Factors & Multi-Digit
units.big_idea: Multiplication can compare quantities and is built from place-value partial products.

units.title: Division with Remainders
units.big_idea: Division shares or groups by place value; remainders must be interpreted in context.

units.title: Fraction Equivalence & Comparison
units.big_idea: The same amount can be named by many fractions; size depends on numerator and denominator together.

units.title: Fraction Operations
units.big_idea: Fractions are built from unit fractions, so we can add, subtract and multiply them by whole numbers.

units.title: Decimal Fractions
units.big_idea: Tenths and hundredths extend place value to the right of the ones.

units.title: Measurement, Area & Perimeter
units.big_idea: Larger units can be expressed in smaller units, and formulas describe area and perimeter.

units.title: Angles & Two-Dimensional Geometry
units.big_idea: Angles are measured in degrees and help us classify shapes.

units.title: Patterns & Year in Review
units.big_idea: Rules generate patterns, and the year's skills combine to solve multistep problems.

weeks.topic: Place value to the hundred thousands
objectives: Name the value of each digit

days.title: Diagnostic & number talk
days.work: Take a 20-question beginning-of-year diagnostic (facts, place value, 3rd-grade fractions) and do a number talk on 99 + 46.

days.title: Building big numbers
days.work: Build 4- and 5-digit numbers with base-ten blocks and record them on a place value chart with period commas.

days.title: Number names
days.work: Write ten numbers up to 999,999 in standard form, word form and expanded form; read them aloud to a parent.

days.title: Value of a digit
days.work: Play 'Digit Detective': draw 6 digit cards, make a number, and state the value of the 7 or 3 in each number made.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Quiz: write 8 numbers in three forms and identify the value of underlined digits.

weeks.assessment: Quiz on three forms of numbers and digit value (80% target).

objectives: Explain that a digit is ten times the value of the same digit one place right

days.title: 10 ones = 1 ten

days.title: Calculator x10 chain
days.work: Enter 3, then multiply by 10 repeatedly to 3,000,000; record each result and describe how the digits shift.

days.title: Millions
days.work: Read populations of California's five largest cities and write each in word and expanded form.

days.title: Compare values
days.work: Solve 10 problems like 'How many times greater is the 5 in 5,200 than the 5 in 520?' and explain one in writing.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Exit ticket: explain with a drawing why the 2 in 2,000 is ten times the 2 in 200.

weeks.assessment: Written explanation with drawing plus 10-problem practice set.

days.title: Compare by place

days.title: Ordering

days.title: Digit card war
days.work: Play 'Place Value War' with digit cards: each player builds the largest 6-digit number and records the comparison.

days.title: Number line placement

days.title: Review & check

objectives: Round to any place using place value and number lines

days.title: Rounding on a number line

days.title: Round to any place

days.title: Unit 1 test

days.title: Estimate first
days.work: Estimate each sum by rounding before computing and circle any answer that is not reasonable.

days.title: Word problems
days.work: Solve 5 two-step addition word problems about miles traveled on a California road trip.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Quiz on multi-digit addition and estimation.

objectives: Subtract multi-digit numbers including across zeros

days.title: Across zeros

days.title: Check with addition
days.work: Check each of 8 differences by adding the difference to the subtrahend.

days.title: Error analysis

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Quiz on subtraction including across zeros.

objectives: Represent problems with equations using a letter for the unknown

days.title: Unit 2 test

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Quiz: write a comparison statement for 4 equations and solve 4 word problems.

objectives: Find all factor pairs for numbers to 100

objectives: Multiply 2- to 4-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers with area models

days.work: Quiz on 1-digit by multi-digit multiplication.

objectives: Multiply 2-digit by 2-digit numbers with area models and partial products

days.title: Real-world model

days.work: Mixed review game: comparison, factors, multiplication strategies.

days.title: Unit 3 test
days.work: Take the Unit 3 test on multiplicative comparison, factors and multiples, and multi-digit multiplication.

days.title: Sharing and grouping

days.title: Dividing multiples of 10

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Quiz on mental division and remainders.

weeks.topic: Division with place value and area models
objectives: Divide up to 4-digit dividends using area models and partial quotients

days.title: Base-ten division

days.title: Area model division
days.work: Use an area model with an unknown side length to solve 4 problems like 432 / 4.

days.title: Partial quotients
days.work: Solve 8 problems with partial quotients, subtracting friendly multiples of the divisor.

days.title: Check with multiplication
days.work: Check 6 quotients by multiplying and adding the remainder.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Quiz on area-model and partial-quotient division.

days.title: Four-digit partial quotients
days.work: Solve 6 problems like 3,624 / 6 using partial quotients.

days.title: Zeros in quotients

days.title: Division puzzles
days.work: Complete a 'missing digit' division puzzle sheet and an error analysis of 3 worked problems.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a quiz with 8 four-digit by one-digit division problems, including zeros in the quotient.

weeks.topic: Multistep problems with all four operations

days.title: Plan the steps

days.title: Remainders in context

days.title: Performance task

days.title: Unit 4 test
